fridgemanager.title: Fridge Guardians
fridgemanager.step1: Pick up each food and carry it to a storage spot.
fridgemanager.step2: Choose the freezer, the fridge or the cupboard. Put whatever cannot be saved into the compost.
fridgemanager.step3: Put a food in the right place and a card tells you why. Press S or tap the gold badge for the source.
fridgemanager.step4: Stars: ⭐⭐⭐ if you need a second try at most once, ⭐⭐ up to 3 times, otherwise ⭐.
fridgemanager.goal: Store all 10 foods safely and learn from every choice!

circularcity.title: The Smart Neighbourhood
circularcity.step1: Pick up an item from the home pile and carry it to the right place.
circularcity.step2: Repair, reuse, recycle or compost. The torn jacket needs repair. The outgrown shirt in good condition goes to reuse.
circularcity.step3: Some right choices open a card with a real fact. Press S or tap the gold badge to see where it came from.
circularcity.step4: Stars: ⭐⭐⭐ for all 8 right first time, ⭐⭐ for 7 of 8, otherwise ⭐.
circularcity.goal: Keep every item out of the landfill!

wheredoesitgrow.title: The Food's Journey
wheredoesitgrow.step1: Carry each food to the place where it grows: on a tree, on a small plant, under the soil, or on a grain stalk.
wheredoesitgrow.step2: Stand beside the right spot and press Enter or Space to plant it.
wheredoesitgrow.step3: Get it right to learn a real food fact. Tap the chip for the source.
wheredoesitgrow.step4: Stars: right first time. 3 of 10 = ⭐, 6 = ⭐⭐, all 10 = ⭐⭐⭐.
wheredoesitgrow.goal: Match every food to the way it really grows!

soildoctor.title: Earth Doctor
soildoctor.step1: Walk up to a sick garden bed and inspect it to spot the problem.
soildoctor.step2: Grab the right natural fix: Mulch, compost, cover crops or no-till.
soildoctor.step3: Heal the garden bed to learn why, then tap the chip for the source. Skip the chemical trap!
soildoctor.step4: Stars: ⭐⭐⭐ with no chemicals and no mistakes, ⭐⭐ with no chemicals and up to 2 mistakes, otherwise ⭐.
soildoctor.goal: Heal all four beds and keep the soil alive!

spotthefake.title: The Food Detective
spotthefake.step1: Walk up to a product and inspect it. See the flashy front, then read the real label on the back.
spotthefake.step2: Decide whether the claim is Supported by evidence ✓ or Needs evidence ? after checking the label.
spotthefake.step3: Watch for sneaky tricks: vague words, fake seals, and sugar listed first.
spotthefake.step4: Stars: right first time. 4 of 6 = ⭐, 5 = ⭐⭐, all 6 = ⭐⭐⭐.
spotthefake.goal: Judge all the products and learn to see through fancy packaging.

planetaryboundaries.title: Planet in Harmony
planetaryboundaries.step1: Walk to a console. Pick one of its two options and see what changes.
planetaryboundaries.step2: Compare two options at each console. One decision can change several limits at once.
planetaryboundaries.step3: Keep no more than 3 limits red. When a card appears, press S or tap the gold badge to see its source.
planetaryboundaries.step4: Stars: the fewer limits still crossed at the end, the better. Up to 1 = ⭐⭐⭐, 2 = ⭐⭐, 3 = ⭐.
planetaryboundaries.goal: Bring at least 4 of the 7 red limits back into the safe zone!

markettrip.title: The Green Basket
markettrip.step1: Every stall has a local and an imported option.
markettrip.step2: Compare the season, the price and the transport points.
markettrip.step3: Pay at the checkout at the end. Until then you can change your mind.
markettrip.goal: Fill the basket with 8 products without going over the money (1 star). Local for whatever is in season (+1). Few transport points (+1).

leftoverchef.title: Culinary Rescue
leftoverchef.step1: Pick up at-risk leftovers and drop them in the Rescue Pot.
leftoverchef.step2: Drop in 2 or 3, then cook to rescue them before they spoil.
leftoverchef.step3: Every dish shows a real food safety tip. Press S or click the gold badge to see where it comes from.
leftoverchef.step4: Stars: each goal you meet gives ⭐. All 3 goals = ⭐⭐⭐.

compostcreator.title: The Super Bin
compostcreator.step1: Pick up one item. Take it to the bin with the matching label.
compostcreator.step2: The game's 5 groups: compost, plastic, drink cartons, aluminium, batteries. Where you live, one bin may collect some of them together. There are also bins for glass and general waste. Batteries go to special collection points. We follow the local rules.
compostcreator.step3: Stuck? Ask the Compost Chef for a hint.
compostcreator.step4: Stars: ⭐⭐⭐ when all 12 are in the right bin.
compostcreator.goal: Sort all 12 items into the right bins!

mealplanner.title: The Chef's Menu
mealplanner.step1: Start with breakfast. Take a food marked “Use first!” from the fridge.
mealplanner.step2: Take from the fridge first. Anything marked “Use first!” will spoil soon. Buy whatever is missing (up to 9 buys).
mealplanner.step3: More points: fruit, vegetables, pulses, grains and foods in season 🍃. Fewer: meat, fish and eggs. Processed foods take points away.
mealplanner.step4: You lose points when a “Use first!” food stays in the fridge, or when you buy what you already have and leave it unused. ⭐ 55 · ⭐⭐ 70 · ⭐⭐⭐ 85
mealplanner.goal: Plan tasty meals while wasting as little food as possible!

gardenplanner.step1: Plant each seed in its correct season. The glowing corner shows you where.
gardenplanner.step2: Water every plant twice so it grows strong and healthy.
gardenplanner.step3: Harvest the healthy crops and compost the wilted ones. That closes the loop!

seasonmatcher.title: The Season Clock
seasonmatcher.step1: Check the country and the season.
seasonmatcher.step2: Put up to 4 foods in your cart. Q or the B button on screen takes out the last one before you pay.
seasonmatcher.step3: Take them to a checkout to see which ones are seasonal.
seasonmatcher.fact: A fruit or vegetable can be in season in one country, but not in another.
seasonmatcher.goal: Find 6 foods that are in season now! Every 2 earn you 1 star, up to 3. Out-of-season picks mean fewer stars.
